description.zh:
身份证人像面图片输入流。
CertUrl和CertFile二选一。
description.en:
The input stream of the portrait side image of the ID card.
Specify either CertUrl or CertFile.

description.zh:
身份证国徽面图片地址。
CertNationalUrl和CertNationalFile二选一，也可以都不传递。
description.en:
The image of the national emblem side of the ID card.
Specify either CertNationalUrl or CertNationalFile. You can also leave both empty.

description.zh:
身份证国徽面图片地址。国徽面
公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接。
CertNationalUrl和CertNationalFile二选一入参，也可以都不传递。
description.en:
The URL of the national emblem side image of the ID card.
A publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL.
Specify either CertNationalUrl or CertNationalFile. You can also leave both empty.

description.zh:
身份证人像面图片。
公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接。
CertUrl和CertFile二选一。
description.en:
The image of the portrait side of the ID card.
A publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL.
Specify either CertUrl or CertFile.

descriptions.zh: 传入身份证正反面，返回权威数据源对二要素的校验结果。
descriptions.en: Takes images of both sides of an ID card and returns the verification result of the two factors from an authoritative data source.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth id-2-meta-verify-with-ocr --cert-url https://www.aliyun.com/cert.jpeg --cert-file '无' --cert-national-url https://www.aliyun.com/cert.jpeg --cert-national-file '无' --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
